name: mcp-diet
stderr:
Usage: mcp-diet [options] [command]

Know where your context goes. Control what loads.

Options:
  -V, --version            output the version number
  -h, --help               display help for command

Commands:
  analyze [options]        Scan all MCP clients and show token costs
  doctor                   Check all servers are reachable
  backup                   Backup all MCP configs
  restore [options]        Restore from backup
  profile                  Manage config profiles
  use [options] <profile>  Switch to a named profile (use "full" to restore all)
  history [options]        Show token usage trends
  activate <license-key>   Activate your mcp-diet Pro license
  help [command]           display help for command
